positions.name: AsyncJobContractGuarantees
positions.frame: What does the ratified async job contract guarantee about latency, durability, and how the agent retrieves results?
positions.why: All three expressions come from the same speaker within a single act of laying out one ratified contract's terms: src-1 states the receipt/cursor mechanics, src-2 asserts the non-blocking/no-loss guarantees those mechanics buy, and src-3 names the 'key decision' — dispatch then poll-or-piggyback — that fulfills them. Read together (technical register, decision-grade conviction, legitimate/rational-persuasion authority throughout) they cohere as one directional read: the contract's design is being asserted as settled and self-justifying, true because of the mechanics it describes rather than beyond them. No tension among the three — each extends the prior clause rather than contesting it.
